name: IN THE CORPSE OF THE PRESENT Prinz Friedrich von Homburg Heinrich von Kleist
description: Marco Fusinato’s IN THE CORPSE OF THE PRESENT unfolds across two levels of the Maxim Gorki Theater for eight hours each day over twenty-one days. The work occupies both the theater’s former foyer, transformed into a stage on the ground floor, and the main theater hall on the first floor. These two…

name: Noise as a Strategy — Workshop
description: When do you long for noise, and when for silence? How do you move through darkness? And when do you wear a mask? In Marco Fusinato’s installation IN THE CORPSE OF THE PRESENT at the Maxim Gorki Theater, Heinrich von Kleist’s The Prince of Homburg meets records played in slow motion, masks…

name: Music of Fears
description: As early as Pythagoras, and later Johannes Kepler, thinkers and scientists imagined the universe as a harmonious interplay of tones inaudible to the ear, yet perceptible to the soul. This utopian idea continues to resonate today: from Hindemith to minimalist composers up to contemporary pop icons…
